summary: First full independent verification of ClipForge. Backend pytest suite (9 tests) all PASS including upload validation, projects CRUD, media serving, uniform 2-clip processing to 1080x1920 H.264 with zip, Whisper transcription + subtitles burn-in on the Italian speech video, and manual render-clip (edit_ prefix, no overwrite). Frontend Playwright E2E full flow PASS: Home -> upload via hidden file input -> /project/:id -> Video info step -> Settings (aspect-9-16, duration-15, count-1, toggle-subtitles off, autofind-toggle off) -> generate -> Processing (job-stage / job-progress-text / job-progress-bar / queue-clip-0 visible with real progress) -> Results (results-title, download-clip-0) -> Editor dialog (all 8 testids visible) -> editor-render triggers re-export toast. One CRITICAL backend bug discovered.

critical.issue: faster-whisper crashes with `ValueError: max() arg is an empty sequence` (transcription.py:29 -> faster_whisper/transcribe.py:419) when VAD removes 100% of audio (e.g. tone-only videos or silence). This propagates out of run_job and marks the whole job as failed with 0 clips. Because auto_find defaults to true in the frontend, ANY upload without real speech fails the default flow. RCA: transcribe() should catch this ValueError and return an empty segment list so run_job can gracefully fall back to uniform_clips. Reproduction: upload /tmp/test_land.mp4, keep defaults (auto_find=true), press generate -> job status becomes 'failed', UI shows 'Nessuna clip generata'. Backend log shows the traceback.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid="clipforge-logo" is rendered twice (Header + Home hero) causing Playwright strict-mode violations. Consider using a distinct testid for the hero logo (e.g. hero-logo) or the Header (already has header-home-btn).

integration_issues.flow: Default settings generate with silent/tone-only video
integration_issues.issue: Because backend crash above, users pressing 'Genera' with default settings on a video without speech land directly on the empty result screen with no error toast context beyond generic failure. Frontend does show toast.error(data.error) when job.status==failed but the UX would benefit from a friendly message once backend degrades gracefully.

action_items: Fix transcription.py to catch faster-whisper's `ValueError: max() arg is an empty sequence` (raised when VAD strips all audio) and return [] so run_job falls back to uniform_clips. Alternatively, in run_job wrap the transcribe(...) call in try/except and, when auto_find is on but transcription fails, log a warning and continue with uniform_clips instead of failing the whole job.
(Nice-to-have) Deduplicate data-testid="clipforge-logo" (used in both Header and Home hero).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py run_job: transcription failure crashes the whole job because there is no per-stage try/except. Should degrade to uniform_clips when transcription fails.
server.py: `Path(name)` sanitize logic for /api/media/clip/{project_id}/{name} correctly rejects traversal, but consider explicit check that resolved parent equals project dir (already done).
pipeline.select_auto_clips relies on segments; when segments==[] falls back to uniform_clips (good).
Frontend DEFAULT_SETTINGS has subtitles:true and auto_find:true which currently guarantees Whisper is invoked for every default generation — expensive on CPU and unsafe given the crash above.

success_rate.backend: 100% (9/9 pytest, but 1 critical runtime bug in edge case)

seed_data_creation: Used pre-existing /tmp/test_land.mp4 and /tmp/test_speech.mp4. Test data uploaded during tests is left in DB/storage (a couple of TEST projects) but the delete_project test verifies cleanup path works.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py can be rerun via `cd /app/backend && pytest tests/backend_test.py -v`. It uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. The Whisper subtest uploads /tmp/test_speech.mp4 and expects to observe the 'Whisper' stage in job.stage plus a non-empty clip.reason. After main agent fixes the transcription crash, please retest by uploading /tmp/test_land.mp4 with default settings (auto_find=true, subtitles=true) via UI — it should now complete via uniform_clips fallback (no subtitles burned since there was no speech).
rca of the issue: faster-whisper (Systran/faster-whisper-base) internally calls `max(prob_dict, key=...)` over detected language probabilities. When VAD filters 100% of the audio (VAD removed 00:16.022 of 00:16.022 for the tone-only test_land.mp4), the probability dict is empty and max() raises ValueError. transcription._transcribe_sync does not guard against this and the exception bubbles up through transcribe() -> run_job outer except, marking the job as failed with 0 clips. Mitigation: wrap the model.transcribe call in try/except ValueError and return ([], info) or [] segments; also add a defensive try in run_job around the Whisper block so any transcription failure degrades to uniform_clips instead of failing the entire job.
